exposure: Laparoscopic repair of previous lower uterine segment caesarean scar defect (PCSD)
outcome: Surgical outcome (successful healing of repair, symptom relief, postoperative anatomic and functional outcomes, shortened period after surgery)
Pregnancy outcome (pregnancy rate, term cesarean delivery, preterm cesarean delivery, artificial abortion, cesarean scar pregnancy)
cohort: The participants were 146 patients diagnosed with previous lower uterine segment caesarean scar defect (PCSD) who underwent laparoscopic repair at the Obstetrics and Gynecology Hospital of Fudan University.
finding: Laparoscopic complete excision of CSD and repair with delayed absorbable material resulted in fair symptom relief and acceptable postoperative anatomic and functional outcomes, with the thickness of the residual myometrium and suturing material being independent risk factors for successful healing of the repair.
followup_time: Up to 32 months for pregnancy outcomes; surgical outcomes followed from April 2010 to July 2015.
